正四面體 Regular Tetrahedron 性質:

每個面都是等邊三角形 equilateral triangle

解題步驟如下:

1) 設邊長為 \(x\)

2) 求 \(OB\) 長度 (Express in \(x\) 以 \(x\) 表示)

3) 運用畢氏定理(\(ΔDBO\))求 \(x\)

\[\begin{align*}
\cos 120^{\circ} &= \frac{OB^2 +OC^2 -BC^2}{2 \cdot OB \cdot OC}\\[3pt]
\frac{-1}{2} &= \frac{OB^2 +OB^2 -x^2}{2OB^2}\ (\because OB=OC)\\[3pt]

\end{align*}\]

\[\begin{align*}
OB^2 + OD^2 &= DB^2\\
\Big ( \frac{x}{\sqrt{3}} \Big ) ^2 + 2^2 &= x^2\\
4 &= x^2 - \frac{x^2}{3}\\
4 &= \frac{2}{3}x^2\\
x^2 &= 6\\
x &= \sqrt6
\end{align*}\]

Base Area 底面積 (\(ΔABC\)面積)

\[\begin{aligned} = \frac{1}{2} \cdot x\cdot x \cdot \sin 60^{\circ}\\ \\
= \frac{1}{2} \cdot x^2 \cdot \frac{\sqrt3}{2}\\ \\
= \frac{1}{2}(6) \frac{\sqrt3}{2}\\ \\
= \frac{3\sqrt3}{2} \end{aligned}\]

Refer to the figure below, the numbers in black are the numbers of dots of each pattern and the numbers in red are their differences. Thus, it can be determined that each difference increases by 2.
